params.prompt:
Scene: A polished studio composite on a dark charcoal #1A1A1A carbon-weave texture, split into a left half and a right half by one thin vertical gold line at the exact horizontal center. LEFT: exactly one generic, unbranded plastic hand tally counter (a small hand-held click counter with a black plastic body, a round metal-grey thumb button on top and a small blank dark mechanical window), visibly worn: scuffed, scratched edges, dull faded plastic, slightly dirty. It has no logo, no brand name, no numerals and no text on it. RIGHT: exactly one black smart ring, the product, floating upright in a three-quarter tilt, glossy, clean, crisp, with a faint warm gold-grey mist behind it. Between the two halves, overlapping the divider line, one round guarantee seal with a gold rim. Along the lower-middle of the frame, one full-width offer bar. The area below the bar is plain background only.

Style: Bold, high-contrast polished studio ad composite (not a phone photo). Dark premium product-photography look with a fine carbon-weave texture, crisp edges, subtle rim lights. The worn object looks tired and flat-lit, the ring looks clean and glowing. Respectful, no mockery, no cartoon.

Lighting: Worn object lit by a flat dull grey top light with soft shadow. Ring lit by a crisp warm key light from upper right with a subtle gold rim light on the band edges. Strong vignette to near-black #0D0D0D at the frame edges. A soft warm gold-grey mist glow behind the ring only.

Camera: Straight-on, eye-level, 85mm product lens, both objects in sharp focus. Both objects shown on the same horizontal axis.

Composition & layout: Vertical 9:16 frame. Headline band: 15% to 31% of frame height, two centered lines spanning 88% of frame width (x 6% to 94%). Subhead: 32% to 36% of height, one centered line, x 6% to 94%. Object zone: 37% to 59% of height. The worn clicker centered at x 25%, height about 17% of frame height, y 39% to 56%. The black ring centered at x 74%, ring height about 21% of frame height (ring outer diameter about 36% of frame width), y 38% to 58%, tilted three-quarter like the reference. Thin gold vertical divider at x 50% from y 38% to 60%, 0.4% wide. Round guarantee seal centered at x 50%, y 47% to 57% (diameter about 20% of frame width), overlapping the divider line. Offer bar: full-bleed horizontal bar from x 0% to 100%, y 61% to 67%. Below 67% only plain background. Top 0% to 14% plain background only, no elements. Focal flow: headline, then worn clicker, then ring, then seal, then bar.

Brand colors: Background charcoal #1A1A1A with carbon weave, vignette #0D0D0D. Headline white #FFFFFF. Subhead light grey #D9D9D9. Divider line, seal rim and offer bar gold #C9A26B. Seal fill deep green #1F5A2E with cream #F5EFE6 text. Offer bar text charcoal #1A1A1A. The ring keeps its own black, white and gold. No orange, no other saturated colors.

Product: Match the attached product reference image exactly: shape, label, colors, logo. Do not redesign, re-letter, simplify or recolor the label. Do not invent label text. Exactly one black metal band ring with a glossy black finish. On its outer face is a flat black rectangular screen showing ONE single horizontal row of four white seven-segment digits reading 5-3-3-2 on the black screen, and beside it a small black rounded-square button with the gold Al Rayan logo, exactly as in the product reference image; the digits never run along the band. The display faces the camera within 25 degrees and is fully visible and sharp. Ring height about 21% of frame height. No hand, no finger, nothing covers the display.

Text: Render exactly four text elements and nothing else.
1) "RETIRE THE LOUD CLICKER" , bold condensed sans-serif, black weight, ALL CAPS, #FFFFFF, centered, in the headline band 15% to 31% of height, broken onto exactly two lines: line 1 "RETIRE THE" and line 2 "LOUD CLICKER", cap height about 7% of frame height, tight line spacing, spanning about 88% of frame width.
2) "Count your dhikr with one silent tap." , clean modern sans-serif, regular weight, sentence case, #D9D9D9, centered on one line at 32% to 36% of height, cap height about 3% of frame height.
3) "60-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE" , inside the round green seal, bold condensed sans-serif, bold, ALL CAPS, cream #F5EFE6, centered, stacked on exactly three lines: line 1 "60-DAY", line 2 "MONEY-BACK", line 3 "GUARANTEE", cap height about 2.8% of frame height, fully inside the seal with margin.
4) "FREE US SHIPPING + 1-YEAR TECH WARRANTY" , on the offer bar (gold #C9A26B), bold condensed sans-serif, bold, ALL CAPS, charcoal #1A1A1A, centered on exactly one line at 62% to 66% of height, spanning about 88% of frame width, cap height about 3.4% of frame height.

Legibility: Spell every word exactly as written inside the quotes, letter for letter, with the same punctuation, case and numerals. "RETIRE" is R-E-T-I-R-E, "CLICKER" is C-L-I-C-K-E-R, "LOUD" is L-O-U-D. "GUARANTEE" is G-U-A-R-A-N-T-E-E. "WARRANTY" is W-A-R-R-A-N-T-Y. "SHIPPING" is S-H-I-P-P-I-N-G. The plus sign in the offer bar is a plain "+". Keep "60-DAY", "MONEY-BACK" and "1-YEAR" with plain hyphens. High contrast on every element, side margins of at least 6%, no letters cut off or touching the edges of the seal or bar. Readable at thumbnail size on a phone. The ring's own display shows only the digits 5332 and the gold logo; the tally counter shows no text. Render only the four quoted strings plus the product's own label; do not render section labels or any other words from these instructions.

Avoid: any text, words, letters or numbers other than the four quoted strings and the ring's own 5332 display; digits running along the ring band; a second ring; a second clicker; hands, fingers or people; brand names or logos on the clicker; profanity; star ratings, review counts, stickers, "off" or sale percentages, "#1", "clinically proven", press logos, scholar or expert imagery; cracked or smashed objects; smoke that hides the ring display; misspelled, warped, mirrored or duplicated letters; cluttered background; watermarks; any text in the top 14% or below 67% of the frame.
